_note: Hand-authored fixture for e1-board.gate.mjs (E1 items 9-13, board + SetBuilder). Declares the SAME local triple shape e1-seeded-triple uses (hipfire GPU0, lemonade GPU1, comfyui GPU1) but carries NO node-agent/swap entry in state.nodes at all — swapNodes(state) then returns [], so App.tsx's per-swap-node serving-status poll and vllm-catalog probe never fire, and this fixture needs no sparky-shaped routes to keep the console clean (unlike e1-seeded-triple, which needed two extra scripted routes for exactly that reason — see its own _note). GET /api/state, /api/storage/state and /api/engine-kinds are each a SINGLE repeat:true entry (R12: a timer-polled route may carry only a constant — App.tsx's POLL_MS=3000 re-fetches /api/state and /api/storage/state every tick regardless of any click, and this fixture never needs either to transition). GET /api/sets is the one route this gate scripts a real transition on, because it is NOT on that poll: SetStrip.tsx:27,36 and SetBuilder.tsx:129,138 each fetch it once on their OWN mount only, so its script only advances on a tab switch or a page reload — both genuine clicks/navigations, never the clock. The scenario seeds ONE saved set, 'with-model', already carrying a placed model (durable.default_route_model='extra.test-model.gguf', ephemeral.resources.lemonade.desired='loaded') so item 11's Load can prove the POSITIVE round-trip (Load genuinely restores a placed model) before proving the negative one (removed — no ghost) — without that positive proof first, the negative check would risk passing vacuously if Load never showed a model at all, working or not. Entries 1-2 (both 'with-model' unchanged) cover the initial SetStrip mount and the first Set Builder tab click; entry 3 covers the refetch after the gate's OWN save-after-removal succeeds; entry 4 (repeat:true) covers the reload's SetStrip remount and the second Set Builder tab click. POST /api/sets carries exactly two entries in click order: a 409 (the set 'with-model' already exists — this IS item 10's fieldset-lockdown proof, reusing item 11's own real first save attempt rather than a throwaway one) followed by a 200 success for the Overwrite retry. No node-editing routes (POST/DELETE .../engines, GET /api/nodes) are scripted — this gate never visits the Nodes tab. Items 12-13 (Task 9) run FIRST, on the default 'deck' view, before the Set Builder tab click above: GET /api/storage/state now carries one cold-store location (engine 'none') plus one resident gguf unit on it, so PlacementActions' Load dropdown offers a cold optgroup entry — App's refreshAll (fired by every PlacementActions action's onRefresh) only re-fetches /api/state and /api/storage/state (both constant/repeat, per R12), never /api/sets or /api/engine-kinds, so none of items 12-13's interactions can perturb the /api/sets sequence staged above. POST /api/tenants/hipfire/park carries a 409 (host-agent-busy phrasing, cited verbatim from app/routers/control.py's _ensure_host_agent_idle f-string — a phrase forceParkCanOverride does NOT fail closed on) then a 200, proving the two-click Force-park arm/confirm contract. POST /api/tenants/lemonade/load carries a 409 (the cold-gguf phrasing cited verbatim from app/routers/control.py:304-305) then a 200 {status:'pulling'} — both the plain attempt and the '?pull=true' retry hit this SAME route key, since the stub keys on pathname only and the query string carries no route identity.
